scope: Additional two passes requested after the first 179-test review; local post-reset networking and credential ordering only

first_pass.subject: Interface presence versus IPv4 address readiness
first_pass.finding: Windows inventory discarded addressless interfaces, so a newly connected wired DHCP interface could not be selected before receiving a lease
first_pass.fix: Opt-in include_unaddressed for factory recovery only; ordinary inspection retains its previous filter; no automatic selection of ambiguous interfaces
verification: Mock native adapter enumeration with zero addresses
Real Qt dialog selects addressless wired interface and starts explicit renewal

second_pass.subject: Pending asynchronous delete versus synchronous new saved password
second_pass.finding: A synchronous Windows save could precede an already pending asynchronous deletion of the same generic credential target
second_pass.fix: Shared password-preference write entry rejects writes to pending-reset targets until deletion completes; canonical identity matches the existing credential key normalization
verification: New write rejected before deletion callback and permitted afterward
Whitespace, port string and username case cannot bypass target match
Other login targets and unrelated normal password writes remain available

official_sources.supports: An interface may have zero or more IP addresses; interface identity and address presence are separate facts
Routes are destination-specific; interface indexes are not persistent identities
Writes replace the credential with the same TargetName and Type
Deletes by TargetName and Type without a credential-generation condition
Connection UUID with ifname selects the intended NetworkManager profile and device

boundaries: No real adapter or credential-store mutation
Debian/Linux branches simulated, not native acceptance
Qt current public documentation checked; version-specific archive/source unavailable in prior review, installed 6.3.2 behavior tested offline
